tess: Quick sync — launch webinar finished. Need replay page copy, short social post, clip picks, and HubSpot lead sync rules. Who's free to triage?

vivian: I'll pull clips. Priorities: benchmark stat (30s), demo CTA (45s), customer quote (20s). Upload to s3 and tag owner in the sheet.

ryan: I'll wire HubSpot: mapping rules = utm_campaign=launch-q2, watched_replay boolean, clip_engaged integer. For any contact with clip_engaged>2 -> sales notify.

ops-bot: upload: recording 3222224520 uploaded -> s3://redwood-marketing/launch-q2/recordings/3222224520.mp4

omar: Got it. @vivian where's the clip sheet?

vivian: tinyurl.com/launch-clip-picks (sheet). I'm flagging timestamps now. Will produce 30s teaser by EOD.

tess: Social post draft: "Watch the launch replay: see performance benchmarks and roadmap. Replay + clips -> link." Keep copy short and include 30s teaser video. Can someone draft two headline variants?

omar: Variant A: "Redwood Launch — watch the replay and see our cost/latency benchmarks". Variant B: "How we made inference cheaper and faster — replay + clips"

ryan: HubSpot note: set lead owner rule: if company_size>500 -> AE queue; else marketing nurture. Also add property "interested_deployment" captured on reg form (hosted/dedicated/private).

tess: Post-event emails: immediate replay (owner: tess), 48h clip email (owner: vivian), 5d deeper dive with benchmark deck (owner: omar). Confirm send windows and segment rules.

ops-bot: transcribe: job tx-3222224550 started -> outputs: srt, plain_text

vivian: I'll mark clip rough cuts and drop links in sheet. If editors needed, ping contractor.

omar: ETA on final replay page copy by 11am PT. Will include UTM params and a short FAQ from the live Qs.

tess: Final: update the post-event triage doc within 4 hours and confirm HubSpot webhooks are firing. If anything breaks ping #marketing-ops and @tess. :rocket:
